description: 8-dimension plain-English audio codebook for the Vegan Playlist musicology project. Keeps immutable uppercase DB keys paired with concise, listener-friendly UI labels (zero emojis) and calibrated AI definitions.

musical_mood.name: Mood
musical_mood.description: The emotional feel of the music itself (harmony, tone, rhythm, vocal delivery), independent of lyrical meaning.

codes.label: Aggressive
codes.listener_description: Furious, visceral, confrontational musical intensity
codes.ai_definition: Visceral musical fury, hostile tension, chaotic violence, or relentless sonic rage conveyed by harsh timbres and intense performance.

codes.label: Dark
codes.listener_description: Foreboding, eerie, bleak, or doom-laden atmosphere
codes.ai_definition: Sinister, ominous, menacing, gloomy, or oppressive sonic atmosphere (minor/dissonant harmony, dark synths, heavy brooding riffs).

codes.label: Mournful
codes.listener_description: Sad, heartbroken, or grieving musical mood
codes.ai_definition: Sorrowful, elegiac, plaintive, heartbroken, or grieving musical mood (wistful melodies, slow minor progressions, weeping vocals).

codes.label: Urgent
codes.listener_description: Anxious, restless, high-alert tension
codes.ai_definition: Pressing, anxious, restless, alarm-like momentum or edgy suspense without full extreme-metal brutality.

codes.label: Empowering
codes.listener_description: Empowering, rallying, fist-raising protest energy
codes.ai_definition: Defiant, rallying, triumphant, resolute, or fist-raising anthemic energy (chorus hooks, gang shouts, uplifting drive).

codes.label: Playful
codes.listener_description: Cheeky, quirky, comedic, or satirical musical feel
codes.ai_definition: Quirky, cheeky, comedic, bouncy, theatrical, or lighthearted satirical musical feel.

codes.label: Upbeat
codes.listener_description: Warm, sunny, celebratory, feel-good positivity
codes.ai_definition: Warm, sunny, bright, cheerful, celebratory, or feel-good major-key musical positivity.

codes.label: Calm
codes.listener_description: Gentle, peaceful, tender, or reflective
codes.ai_definition: Gentle, peaceful, tender, soft, serene, or meditative musical atmosphere.

codes.label: Hypnotic
codes.listener_description: Repetitive, nocturnal, atmospheric, trance-like tension
codes.ai_definition: Trance-like, repetitive, moody, nocturnal, dub/electronic-pulsing, or meditative atmospheric tension.

sonic_intensity.name: Intensity
sonic_intensity.description: Overall physical weight, loudness density, distortion saturation, and kinetic force. Calibrated with objective loudness (LUFS) and tempo.

codes.label: Quiet
codes.listener_description: Soft, stripped-back, solo acoustic, piano, or unaccompanied voice
codes.ai_definition: Quiet, minimal arrangement, soft dynamics, solo acoustic instrument, ambient wash, or unaccompanied spoken voice (typically below -16 LUFS or very sparse without full rhythm section).

codes.label: Moderate
codes.listener_description: Mid-level volume and fullness (indie, folk-rock, dub, laid-back hip-hop)
codes.ai_definition: Conversational volume and balanced density; steady mid-level indie, folk-rock, dub reggae, post-punk ballad, or laid-back hip-hop arrangement.

codes.label: Energetic
codes.listener_description: Lively, punchy, danceable, or fast melodic energy without extreme distortion
codes.ai_definition: Lively, punchy, upbeat energy (ska-punk, pop-punk, energetic folk-punk, danceable rock, upbeat hip-hop/grime) without crushing distortion saturation.

codes.label: Heavy
codes.listener_description: Thick distorted guitars, pounding drums, loud rock, hardcore, or metalcore
codes.ai_definition: Thick high-gain distorted guitars, pounding drums, loud dense hardcore, crust punk, metalcore, or heavy industrial rock (typically high LUFS and saturated mid-band).

codes.label: Extreme
codes.listener_description: Maximum heaviness: blast beats, brutal death metal, or grindcore wall of sound
codes.ai_definition: Maximum sonic saturation and extremity: relentless blast beats, brutal death metal, grindcore, deathcore, powerviolence wall of sound, or punishingly harsh extreme noise/screams.

production_texture.name: Sound
production_texture.description: Recording and timbral aesthetic: acoustic purity, live band warmth, DIY grit, heavy distortion, studio polish, or electronics.

codes.label: Acoustic
codes.listener_description: Unamplified acoustic guitar, piano, strings, and natural room sound
codes.ai_definition: Primarily unamplified acoustic instruments (acoustic guitar, piano, strings, hand percussion) and natural room sound without heavy drums or distortion.

codes.label: Live Band
codes.listener_description: Natural full-band mix with clean/light-crunch electric instruments and live drums
codes.ai_definition: Natural, warm full-band sound with clean or lightly overdriven electric instruments, bass, and live drums (indie, rock, folk-rock, reggae, blues, soul).

codes.label: Raw DIY
codes.listener_description: Gritty, unpolished basement, garage, or underground punk production
codes.ai_definition: Gritty, unpolished, basement/garage/anarcho-punk or underground demo production with audible room bleed, tape hiss, or raw live-room fidelity.

codes.label: Distorted
codes.listener_description: High-gain amplified guitars, heavy fuzz, and saturated metal/hardcore mix
codes.ai_definition: Saturated high-gain amplified guitars, heavy fuzz, aggressive bass distortion, and loud rock, hardcore, or metal mix.

codes.label: Polished
codes.listener_description: Crisp, studio-engineered modern pop, hip-hop, rock, or metal production
codes.ai_definition: Crisp, wide, radio-ready, tightly compressed commercial pop, modern metalcore, or slick studio hip-hop production.

codes.label: Electronic
codes.listener_description: Built mainly around synthesizers, drum machines, samplers, or programmed beats
codes.ai_definition: Driven primarily by synthesizers, drum machines, samplers, turntables, programmed hip-hop/dub beats, or industrial electronics.

codes.label: Experimental
codes.listener_description: Sound collage, avant-garde textures, drone, or sparse spoken soundscape
codes.ai_definition: Sound-collage, unaccompanied spoken-word/poetry recording, avant-garde noise, drone, or field-recording soundscape.

vocal_style.name: Vocals
vocal_style.description: Dominant vocal delivery techniques audible in the recording (select 2 when distinct styles coexist, e.g., harsh verses + melodic chorus or shouted lead + group chants).

codes.label: Melodic
codes.listener_description: Standard pitched singing
codes.ai_definition: Pitched singing voice—ranging from smooth pop/folk/soul to gritty melodic rock or reggae singing.

codes.label: Shouted
codes.listener_description: Urgent punk yelling or hardcore shouting without full metal growls
codes.ai_definition: Unpitched or semi-pitched urgent punk yelling, hardcore barking, or strained shouting without extreme guttural growls or fry shrieks.

codes.label: Screamed / Growled
codes.listener_description: Heavy metalcore shrieks, screams, or guttural death-metal growls
codes.ai_definition: Extreme distorted vocal fry, metalcore/screamo shrieking, guttural death-metal growls, or pig squeals.

codes.label: Group Chants
codes.listener_description: Multiple voices shouting or singing together in a collective chorus
codes.ai_definition: Multiple voices shouting, chanting, or singing together in unison or call-and-response chorus.

codes.label: Rap / Flow
codes.listener_description: Hip-hop rapping, grime MCing, or reggae/dub rhythmic vocal flow
codes.ai_definition: Rhythmic rhyming hip-hop cadence, grime MCing, or Jamaican reggae/dub rhythmic vocal deejay toasting.

codes.label: Spoken Word
codes.listener_description: Spoken poetry, monologue, stand-up comedy, or narration
codes.ai_definition: Unpitched conversational speech, dub poetry, stand-up comedy, dramatic narration, or activist recitation.

codes.label: Instrumental
codes.listener_description: Purely musical track with no lead vocals
codes.ai_definition: Purely instrumental track with no lead singing, rapping, or spoken narrative (minor incidental samples allowed).

rhythmic_feel.name: Rhythm
rhythmic_feel.description: Primary rhythmic engine, beat pattern, and kinetic groove.

codes.label: Blast Beats
codes.listener_description: Hyper-speed double-kick drums, blast beats, or frantic thrash/grind pace
codes.ai_definition: Blistering double-kick drums, blast beats, or hyper-speed grindcore/death-metal/thrash rhythmic velocity.

codes.label: Punk Drive
codes.listener_description: Relentless fast punk gallop and urgent snare drive
codes.ai_definition: Relentless fast punk gallop, d-beat snare drive, or urgent hardcore forward momentum.

codes.label: Breakdowns
codes.listener_description: Heavy chugging riffs and half-time mosh breakdowns
codes.ai_definition: Syncopated heavy chugging riffs, half-time mosh breakdowns, or groove-metal/metalcore stomp.

codes.label: Steady Rock
codes.listener_description: Straight-ahead 4/4 rock, indie, pop, or post-punk backbeat
codes.ai_definition: Straight-ahead 4/4 backbeat typical of indie rock, alternative, classic rock, pop, or post-punk.

codes.label: Groove
codes.listener_description: Bouncy hip-hop head-nod, reggae one-drop, ska offbeat, or funk pocket
codes.ai_definition: Hip-hop head-nod swing, reggae one-drop, ska offbeat skank, funk/soul pocket, or Latin/Caribbean bounce.

codes.label: Acoustic Strum
codes.listener_description: Acoustic guitar strumming, waltz sway, or light folk/blues shuffle
codes.ai_definition: Acoustic guitar/ukulele strumming pulse, waltz sway, or light blues/folk shuffle without heavy rock drums.

codes.label: Electronic Beat
codes.listener_description: Drum-machine pulse, club beat, industrial stomp, or breakbeat
codes.ai_definition: Quantized drum-machine four-on-the-floor, industrial stomp, breakbeat, drum-and-bass, or programmed synth pulse.

codes.label: Beatless
codes.listener_description: No steady drum beat: spoken word, ambient drift, or loose ballad
codes.ai_definition: No steady drum beat: unaccompanied spoken word, ambient drift, drone, rubato ballad, or experimental collage.

instrumentation.name: Instruments
instrumentation.description: Primary audible instruments forming the track's sonic palette (leave empty [] only for unaccompanied a cappella or solo spoken-word tracks).

codes.label: Distorted Guitar
codes.listener_description: Overdriven, fuzz, or high-gain metal/punk electric guitars
codes.ai_definition: Overdriven, fuzz, or high-gain metal/punk/rock electric guitars.

codes.label: Clean Guitar
codes.listener_description: Clean, jangly, reverb-soaked, or ska-skank electric guitars
codes.ai_definition: Clean, chorus, reverb-soaked, ska-skank, or lightly crunchy electric guitars.

codes.label: Acoustic Guitar
codes.listener_description: Acoustic guitar, banjo, ukulele, or mandolin
codes.ai_definition: Steel/nylon acoustic guitar, banjo, ukulele, or mandolin.

codes.label: Live Drums
codes.listener_description: Acoustic drum kit
codes.ai_definition: Acoustic snare, kick, toms, and cymbals played as a live drum kit.

codes.label: Drum Machine
codes.listener_description: Electronic drums, 808s, or sampled hip-hop/industrial beats
codes.ai_definition: Electronic kicks, 808s, industrial percussion loops, or sampled breakbeats.

codes.label: Synths
codes.listener_description: Synthesizers, electronic pads, or turntables
codes.ai_definition: Synth leads, pads, electronic basslines, turntables/scratches, or noise electronics.

codes.label: Piano / Keys
codes.listener_description: Piano, electric piano, organ, or accordion
codes.ai_definition: Acoustic/electric piano, Rhodes, Hammond organ, or accordion.

codes.label: Strings
codes.listener_description: Violin, fiddle, cello, or orchestral strings
codes.ai_definition: Violin, cello, fiddle, viola, or orchestral string sections.

codes.label: Horns
codes.listener_description: Trumpet, saxophone, trombone, or brass section
codes.ai_definition: Trumpet, trombone, saxophone (common in ska-punk, jazz, soul), or flute.

codes.label: Dub / Lead Bass
codes.listener_description: Prominent dub/reggae sub-bass or lead/slap bass hook
codes.ai_definition: ONLY select for deep reggae/dub sub-bass or a prominent slap/melodic lead bassline carrying the main musical hook. NEVER select for ordinary rock, punk, or metal rhythm bass guitar.

audio_samples.name: Audio Samples
audio_samples.description: Non-musical or archival sound insertions embedded anywhere in the track (including intro and outro soundscapes).

codes.label: No Samples
codes.listener_description: Pure musical performance with no embedded clips or sound effects
codes.ai_definition: Purely musical performance with ZERO archival speech clips, news excerpts, animal sounds, sirens, or non-musical sound effects—not even in the intro or outro.

codes.label: Advocate Speech
codes.listener_description: Embedded speech, lecture, interview, or rally quote
codes.ai_definition: Sampled excerpts from speeches, lectures, interviews, activist monologues, or protest rallies embedded in the music (do NOT confuse live stage banter by the band itself unless it is an embedded external speech/sample).

codes.label: Documentary / News
codes.listener_description: TV/radio broadcast, documentary narration, or film dialogue clip
codes.ai_definition: TV/radio news broadcasts, investigative documentary narration, PSA clips, or film dialogue samples.

codes.label: Slaughterhouse Sounds
codes.listener_description: Captive/distressed animal sounds, factory machinery, chains, or gunshots
codes.ai_definition: Sounds of captive/slaughtered animals (mooing, squealing, distress cries), factory-farm/abattoir machinery, saw/industrial drones, chains, or gunshots—including intro or outro SFX.

codes.label: Wildlife / Nature
codes.listener_description: Birdsong, whale/wolf calls, forest, or ocean field recordings
codes.ai_definition: Birdsong, whale/wolf calls, forest/ocean ambience, or peaceful free-living animal field recordings.

codes.label: Sound FX / Crowds
codes.listener_description: Protest crowds, sirens, static, or environmental sound effects
codes.ai_definition: Police sirens, protest crowd chants, radio static, telephone rings, or other environmental/foley sound effects.

dynamic_arc.name: Dynamics
dynamic_arc.description: Temporal energy trajectory across the full song from intro to outro.

codes.label: Relentless
codes.listener_description: Full intensity from start to finish with little let-up
codes.ai_definition: High intensity from start to finish with minimal dynamic drop-off.

codes.label: Steady
codes.listener_description: Even groove and consistent volume across the whole track
codes.ai_definition: Consistent, even dynamics and steady groove maintained throughout (typical of dub, hip-hop, folk, steady pop).

codes.label: Verse–Chorus Shifts
codes.listener_description: Pulls back in verses and swells into bigger choruses
codes.ai_definition: Clear cyclical pull-back in verses alternating with fuller, louder choruses.

codes.label: Quiet Intro, Loud Drop
codes.listener_description: Opens softly (spoken, acoustic, or sample) then detonates into full intensity
codes.ai_definition: Starts quiet/spoken/acoustic or sampled and suddenly detonates into heavy full-band intensity.

codes.label: Slow Build
codes.listener_description: Gradually layers instruments and rises toward a late peak
codes.ai_definition: Layers instruments or rises steadily in tension toward a late climax.

codes.label: Tempo Shifts
codes.listener_description: Sharp gear changes between fast passages, stops, and heavy breakdowns
codes.ai_definition: Sharp structural shifts between fast sections, half-time breakdowns, stops, or tempo transitions.

codes.label: Stripped-Back
codes.listener_description: Delicate, minimal, and quiet from beginning to end
codes.ai_definition: Remains delicate, stripped-back, and low-dynamic across the entire track.

tempo_bpm.description: Median beat tempo in beats per minute.

tempo_stability.description: Beat interval regularity across the track.

dynamic_range_lra.description: Loudness range (P95 minus P10 in LU).

musical_key.description: Estimated tonic pitch and mode, e.g. E minor.

key_confidence.description: Correlation margin between top-1 and top-2 key candidates.

fields.transcript_excerpt: Verbatim 1-2 short sentences heard, or null if non-speech/unintelligible
fields.speaker_or_source: Speaker, documentary, or broadcast name ONLY if unmistakably certain; otherwise null
fields.description: Plain-English description of what is heard

audio_inferred_genre_schema.description: Option B audio-only genre predictions stored in song_audio_analysis without overwriting songs.genre.
